findings.summary: ROLES_REQUIRING_ALLOWED_ROOT is no longer referenced anywhere after the content branch stopped consulting it, and its doc comment still states that dr-worker-content requires --allowed-root — which now contradicts D2 (content allowed_root = spool root). Dead constant with a misleading contract note.

D5 acceptance (criterion 6) asks for 'clue lands blocked, rationale names the digest, zero spawn'. The production-path test asserts zero spawn, spawned:false and writes >= 2, but never asserts the CAS target status is 'blocked' nor that the published rationale names the digest; those two halves of D5 are only covered indirectly.

D4 acceptance (criterion 4) is phrased as 'the anchor published to the bus is literally web://<uri>@<digest>#<range>'. The tests assert on anchorForEvidence/composeAnchor directly; no test drives harvestCard and inspects the anchor captured by publishEvidence for a source:'content' evidence item. The asserted functions are the sole production composer, so the discriminative signal holds, but the bus-level form is not pinned.

composeAnchor keys the double-scheme fix on the locator already starting with 'web://' rather than on source === 'content'. A content evidence item whose locator lacks the scheme still composes 'content://<locator>@<rev>', i.e. the malformed shape D4 forbids. GT-4's verbatim persona shape is covered; the bare-locator variant is not.

The D6 budget accounting consumes 2 writes for every non-null ingestMaterial result, but the D6 born-blocked path (transcribe/fetch failure) publishes only the content-clue and no doc — one write consumed against one write reserved-but-unused. This is conservative (the --max-writes guardrail can never be exceeded) and only slightly over-reserves budget on the failure path.

D7 asks the spool directory to belong to this run and to be recorded in profile and run record. The declared roots are per-profile constants shared across runs with no cleanup (bounded only by the digest-derived idempotent filenames), and the effective spool root is not echoed into RunWriteOutcome or the tick JSON, so a run record does not show where the transcript landed. The prohibited-location half of D7 (not under vault root / .dd-evidence / .dev-dispatch) is declared in all three profiles and asserted by test.

Review-scope caveat: this Final judgment rests on read-only file inspection of the product tree at the I handoff plus the Continuous verdict committed in the RC subject. Acceptance criteria 1 (npm ci / typecheck / test green twice), 10 (Z1 e0-regression on real hardware) and 11 (Z2 live content clue to dr-worker-content) were not executable here, and no acceptance-run report is committed in the worktree; likewise the spec blob's sha256 could not be recomputed, so spec_digest is carried forward from the dispatch as supplied. Criteria 2-9 were assessed by reading the production assembly chain and its tests.
